subject: Onramp Plan: Commitment Accelerator & POC Incentive Proposal
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir@clearstrata.com>; Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearstrata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp MAP draft + incentive proposal for ClearStrata POC

Hi Amir / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great discussion on the latency and cost targets for your ingestion pipeline. As promised, attached is a concise onramp proposal that ties a short pilot to a ramp-to-commit path. High level:

- Pilot: 30-day POC with 200k token credit pool and 2 dedicated test endpoints
- Trial extension: option to extend the pilot by +30 days if two acceptance milestones are met (ingest stability + 1 sample policy evaluation)
- Conversion pricing: staged discount ladder based on first-quarter commit (see term sheet): 10% off list for $X/month commit, 18% for $Y/month, 25% for $Z/month
- MAP milestones: 4-week evaluation plan with deliverables, success criteria, and an executable mutual action plan (attached XLSX)

Two asks from your side to get this scheduled: 1) confirm procurement timeline and 2) let us know if your security team needs an uplifted SOC evidence pack (we can provide a redacted SOC-2 and a short architecture security note).

I attached the draft MAP and a condensed incentive term sheet. If this looks reasonable I suggest a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow to lock in milestones and dates so we can route paperwork to legal. Proposed times: 10:00am or 3:00pm PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearStrata_MAP_Draft.xlsx, POC_Incentive_Termsheet.pdf
From: Amir Patel <amir@clearstrata.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>; Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearstrata.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP draft + incentive proposal for ClearStrata POC

Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear outline. A few quick clarifications before we sync: 

1) Milestones: can you be explicit about the acceptance criteria for the "policy evaluation" milestone? We need a list of tests and expected pass rates to include in our internal signoff.
2) Credits: is the 200k token pool transferrable between teams? We anticipate the ML and Platform teams will both want to run experiments.
3) Legal/procurement: our SOW lead has a procurement freeze until June 10; if you can get the MAP and terms agreed before then we can route approvals the week of June 14. If not, we may need to extend the trial window.

Also, our security lead will request an architecture note and the list of encryption practices for token storage — can you pass that to me (or point me at a page)?

Happy to take the 3pm PT call tomorrow if Kimberly is available.

— Amir
Amir Patel
Head of Data Platform, ClearStrata Analytics
amir@clearstrata.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir@clearstrata.com>; Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearstrata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP draft + incentive proposal for ClearStrata POC

Amir — great questions, answered inline below. Quoting for visibility.

1) Milestones / acceptance criteria (summary):
   - Ingest stability: continuous window of 48 hours with <1% error rate on sample feed; documented runbook for failover
   - Policy evaluation: run the supplied policy suite against 1,000 representative records; acceptance = >= 95% match to expected labels OR documented rationale for any deviations and remediation plan
   - Performance: 99th percentile latency < 250ms for the 512-token evaluation set

We also added a short checklist to the MAP XLSX (tab 2) with example tests your team can run.

2) Credits: the 200k token pool is account-level for the pilot and can be shared across teams; we can tag usage if you want per-team allocation for visibility.

3) Procurement: understood on your timeline. If approvals slip past June 10 we can extend the pilot by +30 days but would need an updated MAP so both sides confirm the new acceptance windows.

Security docs: here's a short packet for your security lead: https://redwood.infra/docs/security/pilot-arch (includes encryption-at-rest/in-transit, key management options, and data retention controls). If they want a live call I can loop in our security engineer.

I can do the 3pm PT call tomorrow. Joining will be Ben (CS lead) and Priya (solutions). I'll bring the updated MAP with the checklist pulled out as an action item.

Thanks — Kimberly

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: approval for extended incentives (ClearStrata)

Kim / Priya — summary from the alignment call: ClearStrata wants the acceptance checklist tightened per Amir's note and needs procurement signed by week of Jun 14. They signalled that if we can get MAP and terms into DocuSign this week, they will prioritize procurement.

Recommendation: we can approve the +30 day extension to the pilot (contingent on the updated MAP and mutual signoff) but I'd like to pull back the credit pool to 150k tokens (from 200k) to limit unit exposure. Offer the per-team tagging and an option to request a one-time top-up if they hit specific acceptance gates.

If you're both comfortable with that concession I will route to Finance to accept the change in the incentive term sheet and prepare the DocuSign package (RWI-2027-3185).

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
